messages:
elaine: heads-up — we need to finalize the per-route throttle + billing labels for the next release. customer asks keep coming: per-endpoint quotas, different pricing for chat vs embeddings, and predictable token accounting.
raj: thanks — do we want a single "route_tag" field that ties to billing, quotas, and telemetry? makes downstream joins easier.
mike: +1 for a route_tag, but we need enforcement touchpoints: api-gateway -> rate-limiter -> accounting. how do we handle streaming/chunked responses and tool-calls when counting tokens?
elaine: good call. proposal: route_tag (string) + billing_product (enum: chat, embed, rerank, toolcall) + token_weight_factor (float). token accounting rules: count tokens for user prompt + model output; for tool-calls count tool input separately with a configurable multiplier.
nana: small nit — we should call it "billing_surface" not billing_product to allow future expansion (e.g., hybrid rerank+embed).
raj: updated naming sgtm. Another open question: do we meter per-route limits per-minute or per-second? customers want burst but also predictable daily spend caps.
mike: infra prefers token/s for enforcement and token/day for billing caps. enforcement code easier at s granularity.
elaine: launch criteria draft: 1) API accepts route_tag + billing_surface in request metadata, 2) enforcement works at token/s with soft bursts, 3) daily spend cap honored (reject with 402-like response), 4) telemetry shows per-route token and request breakouts in console.
raj: pricing implications — we need an attribute in usage records: "route_billing_label" and "unit_type" (prompt, completion, tool_input). That lets billing pipeline attribute costs correctly.
mike: pragmatic rollout: phase 1 — read-only route_tag (telemetry only) for 2 weeks; phase 2 — enforcement enabled for 10% of traffic with canary; phase 3 — global enforcement + billing labels emitted.
elaine: agreed. can we have code snippet for client metadata header?
mike: sure — paste below:
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer $KEY
  X-Redwood-Route: "checkout-recs-v2"
  X-Redwood-Billing-Surface: "chat"
  X-Redwood-Token-Factor: "1.0"
```

ana: what about function/tool calling? when a model calls an external tool we double-count tokens (request->tool->model). we should define canonical attribution: tool invocation tokens counted as tool_input with configurable factor; model output still counted as completion.
raj: customers with heavy embedding workloads want per-route per-minute rate-limits and separate per-embedding-unit pricing. recommend we expose "unit_type: embedding" and separate metering pipeline path.
mike: ops question — do we let route_tag map to different quotas per environment (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? implementation complexity increases.
elaine: for launch support hosted and dedicated, private can be opt-in later. map route_tag to tiered defaults per deployment mode. document in the SDK and console.
pricing-bot: proposal saved: "route_tag + billing_surface + unit_type". Created PR #4021 for usage record schema changes.
raj: action items: 1) pricing team to finalize unit multipliers and default rates (raj), 2) infra to implement token/s enforcement and telemetry (mike), 3) devex to add headers + SDK helpers (ana), 4) PM to draft launch docs and canary plan (elaine).
nana: quick UX ask — console should let customers create route profiles (name, quota/day, burst token/s, billing_surface) and preview monthly cost.
mike: note — edge-proxy caching could reduce measured tokens. telemetry needs to show estimated charged tokens vs observed tokens. add a flag "charged_tokens_estimate" to usage record.
elaine: final question for negotiation: do we require customers to opt in to per-route billing labels, or default to a single global route? some customers will not set tags and expect sane defaults.
raj: default = global_route, but encourage tagging via credits and sample configs. migration plan in the PR.
nana: sounds good. i'll sketch console mockups.
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll turn these notes into an RFC this afternoon and ping for signoffs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 1767895000 — route-tag read-only telemetry only.
